args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it wasn't a candidate).

2. **Rolled back:** Rolled out v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback verification confirms the service is now **healthy** with an error rate of 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident:** Filed SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified.
